The marine's mind can be controlled by DOOM, playing on a map generated by DOOMFORMER.

stories.title: Launch HN: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents
summary: We are building the simulation layer that lets engineers and AI agents test and validate firmware without hardware.Before Simantic, we were ex-firmware engineers at companies like Neuralink and Tesla.
We built our MVP that was essentially a wrapper around Renode, but we quickly realized there were a lot of limitations to doing this.1.
Renode was released in 2017, which was when all code was still being written by hand, so I think it made sense looking back, but there were limitations because of the language itself.3.
